purpose: Ingest authoritative sources surfaced by raw states 39359 and 33959 and route associated information-security/formal-modeling discoveries, while preserving all matched identifiers as nonphysical Glob controls.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, standard, method, software resource, operational precedent, commercial signal or information item receives a Worldshepherd use when it materially improves any capability, or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate MHRA certificate views, NVD/vendor advisory mirrors and repeated bibliographic records are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: CVE IDs, GMP certificate numbers, national-standard numbers, ISBN components and postal codes may be operationally valuable but are not Glob evidence unless the digits independently encode a verified physical quantity.

sources.title: CVE-2023-33959 — OCI artifact verification identity mismatch in notation-go
sources.authority: NIST National Vulnerability Database / Notary Project advisory
sources.note: Use as an artifact-provenance control case: compromised registry state can cause verification of the wrong artifact. 33959 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: GB/T 33959-2017 — Stainless steel bars for the reinforcement of concrete
sources.authority: State Administration for Market Regulation / Standardization Administration of China
sources.note: Use as a civil/material standards reference for stainless reinforcement. 33959 is the standard number.

sources.title: UK API 39359 GMP compliance record — Shanghai Desano Chemical Pharmaceutical
sources.authority: UK Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency
sources.note: Use regulated-site identity, inspected operations and physical/chemical QC scope as a manufacturing due-diligence schema reference. 39359 is certificate metadata.

information_updates.finding: Worldshepherd software-supply-chain controls should verify not only that an OCI artifact is signed, but that the verified digest/identity is exactly the artifact selected for use after registry resolution. Registry trust and signature trust are separate controls.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Derived from CVE-2023-33959; no claim is made that current Worldshepherd images use the vulnerable library.

information_updates.finding: The MHRA record supplies a reusable supplier/facility due-diligence structure: authority, site identity, inspection date, validity caveats, licensed operations, named substances and QC testing scope.
information_updates.claims_boundary: The source is a manufacturing-governance reference; 39359 remains metadata.

information_updates.finding: The 99353 metadata neighborhood surfaced UML-to-Alloy transformation and FPGA NIDS literature, which should be retained in the retrospective software/formal-verification and security-acceleration corpus despite the matched digits being ISBN components.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Bibliographic digits contribute zero Glob evidence.
